title: Ops rotation digest — morning->evening (2026-03-20)
content:
Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Short service blip in embeddings.kv-cache in eu-west-1 between 2026-03-20T08:14Z and 2026-03-20T08:27Z. Surface symptom: elevated HTTP 5xx for /v1/embeddings, p95 latency spike. Root cause appears to be a cascade of Redis connection resets after a config change pushed to proxy pool.
- Impact: ~2.3% error rate for embeddings traffic in eu-west-1 during window; no customer SLA breach (global fallbacks served), some increased latency for a subset of PLG accounts.
- Immediate mitigation: rolled back proxy pool config at 08:20Z, autoscaled embedding workers + enabled fallback-model routing for 12 minutes, connection pool limits adjusted at 08:22Z. Full service recovery by 08:28Z.

Timeline (local times in UTC):
- 08:10 - Change to proxy pool max_connections deployed (PR #1234) — intended to reduce idle sockets.
- 08:13 - Pager alert: embeddings-p95-eu-west1 > 400ms (alert threshold 300ms).
- 08:14 - Spike in 500s observed; first on-call ack (Asha).
- 08:15 - Quick triage: consistent Redis ECONNRESET from proxy logs (eu-west-1-proxy-3).
- 08:17 - Elevated error rate triggers customer-impact escalation; notify platform-engineering and routing team.
- 08:20 - Rollback proxy pool change; revert to previous max_connections of 1024.
- 08:22 - Adjusted worker connection limiter in serve-config to 900 concurrent requests.
- 08:26 - Fallback routing for embeddings enabled (auto-route to warmed dedicated pool).
- 08:28 - Metrics show p95 returning to baseline; alerts resolved 08:30.

Observed metrics:
- embeddings service (eu-west-1):
  - baseline p95 ~120ms -> peak 560ms during incident window
  - 5xx rate baseline ~0.02% -> incident peak 2.3%
  - redis proxy connection reset rate increased x18 for proxy-3 instance

What we ran / commands + snippets (copied for runbook):
- kubectl -n prod logs eu-west1-proxy-3 | grep ECONNRESET -- shows repeated resets at 08:14:02 -> 08:20:00
- redis-cli -h eu-west1-kv-01 INFO clients | grep connected_clients
- curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' 'https://embeddings.eu-west-1.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings' -- test synthetic showed 500 -> 200 after rollback

Initial root cause hypothesis (concurrent):
- The proxy pool change lowered the effective per-client timeout/keepalive behavior; in combination with a micro-burst from one heavy retriever job (customer: corp-alpha) this exhausted ephemeral sockets and caused resets on the proxy leading to upstream 5xx.
- Secondary contributor: the proxy's connection-reuse logic has a known race when TCP keepalive interactions coincide with upstream worker restarts.

Actions taken (incidents):
- Immediate: rollback config, increase worker connection limit, enable fallback routing.
- Short-term follow-ups (this rotation): see action items below.

Action items / follow-ups (owners and due dates):
- SRE-4217 (owner: Yuna Kim) - Full incident postmortem draft due 2026-03-23. Include timeline, root cause analysis, and telemetry plots.
- Update runbook: add 'proxy-config-change checklist' (owner: Asha Patel) - due 2026-03-22. Include pre-deploy traffic canary steps, socket exhaustion checks, and command list to revert.
- Add an alert for 'redis-proxy-connreset-rate > 10x baseline' with a 2-min evaluation window (owner: Ethan Zhao) - due 2026-03-21.
- Platform: add a guard in config-deployer to require a staged deploy for proxy-pool changes above threshold (owner: Miguel Romero, platform-engineering) - target 2026-04-02.
- Product ops: contact corp-alpha to request query pattern detail and coordinate rate-limiting if needed (owner: customer-success) - POC assigned in ticket.

Runbook draft notes (to be migrated to Confluence under SRE playbooks):
- Title: Embeddings - Redis proxy connection flapping
- Symptoms: sudden spike in 5xx for embeddings endpoints + repeated ECONNRESET in proxy logs + increased redis slowlog/timeout counts
- Quick checks:
  1) Check alert graph for p95 and 5xx and correlate with deploy timeline.
  2) kubectl logs eu-west1-proxy-* | grep ECONNRESET and note affected replica IDs.
  3) redis-cli INFO clients and monitor connected_clients.
  4) Check deploy history: gh pr list --author platform-bot --since "2h" and identify config changes.
- Mitigations (order):
  A) If deploy in last 30m -> revert change and monitor for 10m.
  B) If revert not possible -> increase worker connection limits and enable fallback routing to dedicated pool.
  C) If still failing -> scale up redis proxies by +1 replica and drain traffic from the affected proxy.
- Post-incident: add steps to canary via synthetic traffic and require 30m observation window before global rollout.

Notes to next rotation (bullet handoff):
- We rolled back PR #1234; the production config is back to previous baseline. Monitor embeddings p95 and 5xx for next 4h particularly around 09:00 and 12:00 UTC where corp-alpha runs scheduled jobs.
- Yuna will start the postmortem draft tomorrow AM. Please ping her if you have logs or cluster traces to add.
- Alert threshold change is in progress (Ethan), expect new alert in ~24h after verification.
- Watch for residual flakey proxies: eu-west1-proxy-1 showed some CREEST (minor) re-tries between 08:30-08:35; not currently critical.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Is the proxy library's keepalive behavior impacted by the kernel upgrade we did last week? (platform-engineering follow-up)
- Should we add per-customer burst detection to routing to avoid single-customer storms? Product/CS input required.

Misc notes (handy links and refs):
- Quick slog: /var/log/proxy/eu-west1-proxy-3.log.gz (internal) - rotated daily.
- Grafana dashboards: Embeddings-EU-West1 (p95/5xx) + Redis Proxy Health panel.
- Related docs: 'connection-poolting-anti-patterns' Confluence page (link in linked_artifacts).

Sign-off: Asha Patel (primary responder), Miguel Romero (platform consulted), Yuna Kim (postmortem owner).

Next rotation assignment: night rotation to Ethan Zhao at 19:00 UTC. Please watch for delayed regressions and confirm alert changes after Ethan finishes validation.

Raw notes / quick brain-dump (unstructured):
- Note to self: remind platform to include a deploy flag "--staged-proxy" to enforce canary for config-only changes.
- Ran synthetic test against warm pool; noticed slightly higher tail when warm pool capacity under 30% utilization -> might need reserved slots for PLG accounts.
- Customer slack message drafted for corp-alpha ops asking for any recent job pattern changes; waiting on reply.

End of digest.
